title: AI-led discovery and costlier PCs mean our store must win on AI visibility
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); HP launched Experience AI; TikTok and Gap added AI shopping. Gartner: Q3 PC shipments fell 22.4% as costs lifted ASPs; Surface Laptop Ultra is $2,599.

points.headline: AI discovery is mainstream and rivals are rebuilding their stores for it
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% use AI in discovery; HP launched an agentic web platform; TikTok and Gap added AI shopping. Make our product data and search work for AI tools and plain-language queries.

points.headline: PC volume is falling while component costs push prices up
points.detail: Gartner reports Q3 shipments down 22.4% with higher ASPs; memory is prioritised for servers. Plan pricing, configurations and stock messaging for a smaller, costlier market.

points.headline: Premium AI laptops are pricing up and going on sale direct
points.detail: Surface Laptop Ultra is $2,599 and Nvidia RTX Windows laptops are open for pre-order. Set price anchors and merchandising for our top-end AI PCs.

points.headline: Electronics drive peak sales events on marketplaces
points.detail: Prime Big Deal Days hit $9.86B in US online sales with electronics up 85%; Amazon India expects a 35-40% festive spike. Line up promotions, stock and delivery promises early.
